content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the cap / floor form, each Save click is followed by a loading overlay and then a visible error (app:38, app:45, app:52), and each time the user returns focus to the Notional input (325, 360, 409) before pressing Save again, so the Save-time error appears to be tied to the Notional entry, though the events do not name the field that failed validation.", "fix": "Fix: On the cap / floor form, change the Save-triggered error so it names the invalid field and moves focus to it, and show an inline error directly under the Notional input on blur so the problem is visible before Save is pressed.", "cited_event_ids": ["325", "339", "340:w366", "app:38", "360", "363", "388", "app:45", "409", "412", "435", "app:52"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The text or target of the visible error messages is not in the events, so it is not confirmed that Notional is the field failing validation.", "Input values are masked, so the Notional value entered and any validation rule cannot be verified.", "The overlay after Save is not labelled, so it is not confirmed whether it is a loader, a validation step or a server call.", "The facts report no abandonment and no time lost, so the impact on completion is unverified beyond the window.", "Only one session window is provided, so the pattern cannot be checked across the other five sessions."]}
